target_customer: Machine learning teams at autonomous vehicle, mapping, drone and other computer vision companies
problem: Computer vision models need large amounts of accurately labeled data; Playment provides managed labeling using a crowd of microtask workers plus internal experts.
business_model: Managed service and platform priced per labeled unit

founders.name: Siddharth Mall
founders.background_notes: YC page: ran product and technology for a 400M dollar portfolio. Inc42 says IIT Kharagpur alumnus.

founders.name: Akshay Lal
founders.background_notes: Inc42 says IIT Kharagpur alumnus; YC page says he led product.

founders.name: Ajinkya Malasane
founders.background_notes: Inc42 says IIT Guwahati alumnus; YC page says co-founded Playment as Head of Business 2015 to 2021.

competitors.name: Amazon Mechanical Turk
competitors.traction_then: named by Inc42 as a competitor

competitors.name: CrowdFlower
competitors.traction_then: named by Inc42 as a Valley competitor

technical_complexity.rationale: A crowd workflow platform with quality control and annotation tools; operational scale mattered more than research.

defensibility.rationale: A trained workforce of 250,000 plus workers and customer integrations helped, but Scale AI and others offered similar services.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: TELUS International bought Playment in July 2021 after buying Lionbridge AI.

market_need_then: Autonomous driving and computer vision projects needed labeled data in 2017; Inc42 reported over 250,000 crowd workers and customers in AV, visual search, satellite imagery and OCR.

identity.voice_and_tone: Workers called players, a gamified microtask framing per Inc42

brand_strength.rationale: Name suggests gaming and no brand press was found; B2B buyers cared about quality, and the site now redirects to TELUS.

pivots.to: Focus on training data for autonomous vehicles and computer vision
pivots.why: Analytics India Magazine headline and Inc42 describe the autonomous vehicle focus; reasons not stated

outcome_analysis: Playment raised about 2.3 million dollars in two reported rounds, focused on computer vision training data for autonomous vehicles as demand grew, and reached roughly 50 employees and over 200 ML team customers. TELUS International acquired it in July 2021 for undisclosed terms to add scaled annotation capacity after Lionbridge AI. It was a capital efficient strategic exit.
notes: playment.io redirects to TELUS International AI Data Solutions. Funding totals conflict: Inc42 acquisition piece 2.5M, CB Insights 3.35M, Wellfound 3M; round list covers 2.3M. Saif amount and date come from the Inc42 2017 article (July 2016, 699K, with pro rata raising the pre-series A total to 2.2M). The Business Wire release returned 403 so the deal was confirmed through search results listing it and TELUS's 40-F. Prior employers: Inc42 says the group is the Flipkart Mafia, which does not name individual roles. Founding date 2015 per Inc42 (launched November 2015) though YC lists W17. Confidence high because founders, competitors and funding are sourced.
